To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the incidence of polymorphism in the genes of the renin-angio- tensin-aldosterone system in Uzbek patients with EH corresponds to this in the European population.
The most unfavorable combinations of the alleles of the studied genes are associated with the severity of LVH and vascular remodeling.

in patients with EH of Uzbek nationality there is primarily combined carriage of destroying alleles of the genes ACE and CYP11B, which is associated with the most unfavourable combination 235T/1166C and is associated with severity of LVH and vascular remodeling.
In summary, our research is concerned with
detection of most favourable and unfavourable gene combinations in Uzbek patients with EH.
identification of the most unfavourable gene combinations in Uzbek males with EH, associated with severity of LVH and vascular remodeling.
the role of gene polymorphism in the development of cardiovascular remodeling in EH of Uzbek nationality.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

polymorphism of the genes ACE and AT1R has the most pronounced impact on severity of LVH; polymorphism of ANG and CYP11B1 genes has the most pronounced effect on vasoregulatory and endothelial function, respectively.
the most unfavourable combination in relation to the severity of LVH is D+235T, and in relation to vasoregulatory disorders of endothelium and atherosclerosis - 1166C+235T.
the most important gene combinations in development of LV and vascular remodeling in EH patients of Uzbek nationality are: D+235T, 235T+1166C, D+1166C.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the role of 235Т allele in the ANG gene is more important for development of left ventricle hypertrophy, and the 1166С allele of AT1Р gene is more important in the development of vascular endothelial dysfunction.
the most unfavourable gene combination for development of LVH is DD+235T+1166C.
the most unfavorable gene combinations are those that include the D allele of ACE, T allele of the ANG gene, C allele of AT1 receptor gene, and the T allele of the CYP11B gene.
The main takeaway from our work is that
polymorphic markers of genes ACE, CVP11B2, AT1R and ANG can be used in Uzbek patients with EH as markers of severity of LVH and vascular remodeling.
in Uzbek population the most unfavourable gene combinations are associated with severity of left ventricular remodeling and vasoregulatory dysfunction.
the role of the genes ACE and ANG in development of LV and carotid atherosclerosis in Uzbek patients is more important than that of the genes CYP11B1 and AT1R.
